interpretation.paths: Relative to this file. JSON pointers use RFC6901; an empty pointer denotes the complete JSON document.
interpretation.observation_units: Cases, calls, criteria, records, projections and pages are distinct and must not be summed into a success rate.
interpretation.source_identity: Each study evidence/origin.json distinguishes exact original JSON, rendered prose views, metadata extractions and new public demonstration outputs.
interpretation.scientific_force: A recorded pass concerns its stated finite predicate. Neither hash equality, an expected unresolved decision nor a strong-comparator tie establishes semantic truth or superiority.
interpretation.new_code: New public reproduction programs are explicitly separated from retained historical experiments.
interpretation.review: This index does not itself confer independent review, production readiness or current authority.
interpretation.counting: Ordinary, boundary/stress, development and regression denominators remain separate. Nested criteria and algebraically related subsets are not independent samples.
interpretation.review_corrections: review-corrections.json identifies new programs without mutating the 47 retained evidence files or six origins.
interpretation.language: evidence-language-index.json records representation languages and English summary locations.
interpretation.historical_recovery: historical-recovery-gaps.json records exact missing identities, a recovered matching schema, and a rejected nonmatching implementation candidate.

claims.statement: The retained finite implementation matched the expected ordinary outcomes in its author and separate-control suites.
claims.model: Interpreted JSON instances; conjunctive core and profile obligations; supplied context.
claims.test_or_argument: 35 author development/regression scenarios (13 expected positive outcomes, 22 expected rejections) and 26 separately composed ordinary controls (6 expected positive outcomes, 17 expected rejections, 3 migration/preservation); stress cases excluded.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: A checker that always rejects would fail the positive controls; false trusted inputs expose a different boundary.
limits: Purposefully selected finite inputs, not a population error rate.
Separate agent within the same session, not external replication.
Complete historical runners and fixture closure are not distributed here.

Author inputs informed development; separate controls are same-session authored scenarios, not a random held-out population. Four of six admission-positive controls are application operations, one execution and one compatibility.
claims.public_reproduction: retained_reports_inspectable; no complete historical replay closure

claims.statement: Self-consistent false trusted inputs can pass structural and relational checks.
claims.model: Source annotations, capability, authority and availability are supplied inputs.
claims.test_or_argument: Two author and four separate-control stress cases.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: Fabricated capability, fabricated grant, false subject content, and incorrect availability remained structurally admissible.
limits: Acceptance under the interface does not authenticate any external premise.
These acceptances are not semantic success.

claims.statement: No correctness advantage was established over the strong direct checker on the nine shared cases.
claims.model: Same essential bindings and supplied data; fixed fields versus extensible profile representation.
claims.test_or_argument: Post-first-run exploratory comparison on nine known inputs and known expected outcomes: three allowed and six forbidden.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: A direct checker made the same decisions. The ablation admitted all nine inputs, including six forbidden ones, and its separate empty-task calibration is outside this denominator.
limits: The comparator author knew these inputs and oracles; equality is an existence demonstration, not held-out generalization.
Exploratory after results disclosure.
Contract side uses retained first-run outputs.
No latency, cost, maintainability or professional outcomes measured.

claims.statement: If admission is the conjunction of core and applicable profile conditions, admission implies the core condition.
claims.model: Admit(x) implies C0(x) and C1(x) and ... and Cn(x).
claims.test_or_argument: Conjunction elimination, with finite cases checking selected implementations.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: An overriding profile or an incorrectly optional requirement violates a premise of the argument.
claims.result: The logical implication holds under the stated definition; implementation coverage is finite.
limits: No automatic discovery of applicability from unrestricted language.
This does not prove the absence of all implementation defects.

claims.statement: The extracted historical dependency graph satisfies the tested closure laws for all selectable skill subsets.
claims.model: Required all-dependencies on a fixed 110-vertex graph with twelve skill roots.
claims.test_or_argument: DFS versus a separately written same-workflow least fixed point; idempotence, singleton-union equation, and one-step inclusion monotonicity. New review checks count record closures and distinguish three declared traversal mutants.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: Unknown roots and cycles are rejected; an omitted semantic dependency is not discoverable from this adjacency relation.
limits: Only the fixed declared graph is exhaustive.
The public replay does not rerun the complete historical 46-check package suite.
No semantic completeness or agent competence follows.
4096 subsets and 24576 related inclusion pairs are finite exhaustive algebraic checks, not independent empirical observations.
The new 3-mutant result is bounded by its declared fault model. Record counts do not measure bytes, tokens, economic efficiency or semantic dependency completeness.

claims.statement: A protected literal can survive while the sentence changes meaning.
claims.model: Literal-presence and structural validators operate on declared strings and shapes.
claims.test_or_argument: The historical 46 rows comprise 44 ordinary checks (21 acceptance, 23 rejection) and two accepted misleading-input boundary cases.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: Negation changes the proposition while retaining the exact number; a false rule can satisfy the schema.
claims.result: Both limited checks accepted their deliberately misleading inputs, exposing their boundaries.
limits: The expected acceptance is a boundary observation, not successful semantic validation.
The two accepted false/misleading inputs are excluded from the ordinary denominator, consistently with the contract-profile study.
claims.public_reproduction: retained_selftest; public graph replay does not repeat these package cases

claims.statement: The migration tool reported unchanged payloads and source bytes for all 110 artifacts; the published report does not itself contain two independently comparable byte inventories.
claims.model: Stable artifact and revision identities are distinct from filesystem paths.
claims.test_or_argument: One recorded hash and bytes_equal assertion per artifact, aggregate records_unchanged/source_bytes_unchanged, and nine layout checks with negative controls.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: A broken link with an updated hash and a registry/index disagreement are rejected; hashes alone do not prove navigation.
limits: Old and new bytes or separate old/new hashes are not both published; byte equality is the tool’s assertion, not a newly independent re-comparison.
Inventory and path correctness do not establish source truth.
No new model outcomes or native clients were evaluated by the migration.

claims.statement: The pinned historical replay reproduced an unresolved preliminary decision rather than server admission.
claims.model: Exact historical target manifest, environment and command expectations.
claims.test_or_argument: Five exits [0,0,0,3,0], before/after preservation, selftest reproduction.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: An expected needs_resolution can pass a replay gate while the package remains unadmitted.
limits: No new model runs or new text outcomes.
No external semantic review; server admission not evaluated.
Environment match belongs to the pinned historical package, not every later layout.
claims.public_reproduction: retained_package_reports; restricted source closure is not redistributed

claims.statement: The three readable outputs were reconstructed exactly while all 153 nonempty explicit uncertainty fields were omitted from their corresponding descriptions.
claims.model: Source documents, edit ledgers and structured generated descriptions are projected to readable Markdown.
claims.test_or_argument: Known-corpus reconstruction and field-to-projection audit.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: Reproducibly omitting the same field preserves output hashes but loses a declared qualification.
limits: Mapping was developed after inspecting known examples.
Source JSON retained the fields; the defect is in the readable projection.
Not a claim that every description lacks all cautious wording.
Structural table counts reused a shared lexical detector, not an independent semantic table verifier.
The later 917-description structural audit inspected zero image byte files; the earlier reader’s 3 PNG/918 observation and separate addressability study’s 3 JPEG checks are different stages.
claims.public_reproduction: historical_audit_report; synthetic public program demonstrates the mechanism only

claims.statement: The separate derivative delivered all explicit uncertainty values and provenance markers while retaining a reversible mapping to the original readable output.
claims.model: Declared insertions with source-row, record, anchor and output-range bindings.
claims.test_or_argument: Profile and expected counts fixed before derivative generation after diagnosis.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: A plain serializer implementing the same rule can achieve this result; graph superiority does not follow.
limits: No new OCR or subject model inference in this transformation.
Unreviewed uncertainty statements are not calibrated error probabilities.
Four public synthetic records are distinct from the historical corpus.

The corrected four-record illustration checks a separately stored literal target and a damaged trace; it does not reproduce the historical source-plus-ledger reconstruction or prove its 917/153 counts.
claims.public_reproduction: Historical result is retained-report evidence; new illustration: python3 engineering/studies/source-transcription-and-uncertainty/checks/demonstrate_uncertainty_projection.py

claims.statement: Unresolved source coordinates and correction traces identify provenance gaps, not measured OCR errors.
claims.model: Flags and raw/document/readable representations use explicitly mapped coordinate spaces.
claims.test_or_argument: Audit of 5538 flags and navigation correction rows: 16 table/formula flags + 4 orphan flags + 5 correction rows = 25 unresolved coordinate traces.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: A missing anchor or vanished flag can reflect representation changes without proving recognition correction.
limits: CER and WER remain unmeasured/null.
No complete independent ground truth.
Missing producer trace does not establish that five recognized passages are wrong.
claims.public_reproduction: retained_audit_inspectable; original source packages needed for historical replay

claims.statement: The later local export integration preserved declared fields but was not installed in the upstream producer.
claims.model: Post-export serializer, independent validator and snapshot publication.
claims.test_or_argument: Two runs over 917 records; initial controls and separate corrections retained.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: The first authored C04 used the wrong serialization and stopped before its intended check; the correction is a separate run.
limits: No physical power-loss test.
Local visibility is not confirmed durability.
No new model, OCR, or human-review calls in these export runs.

claims.statement: Address resolution, content availability, revision inference and diagnostic coordinate space require distinct representations.
claims.model: Revised finite packet reader and interpretation mapping.
claims.test_or_argument: 38 calls: 26 counterexamples authored alongside the changes and 12 earlier regression cases; not held-out qualification.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: A placeholder can have a resolved address but unavailable content; choosing the first conflicting candidate invents uniqueness.
limits: Reader, mapping and rubric changed.
This is not instrument-only causal comparison or general accuracy.
Nested criteria are not independent cases.
The initial 57 calls had statuses 10 complete, 38 partial, 3 rejected, 6 unsupported; retained aggregate status counts do not bind every partial status to a predeclared expectation.
Four failure groups changed both implementation and sometimes rubric/contract; the material does not causally allocate improvement to either change.

claims.statement: The graph and equally informed flat-row representation produced equal results in all thirty targeted revision pairs.
claims.model: Shared evidence validator and serializer; different affected-record selection representation.
claims.test_or_argument: Ten operation templates crossed with three books: 30 pairs, 60 executions, with a shared validator and serializer.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: The strong simple representation handles the same declared dependencies without a graph advantage on this scope.
limits: Unresolved and unknown records are intended visible outcomes, not empirical truth.
No native model or human subject calls.
Single local timing is not product or model latency.
Repeated instantiations across books are not 30 independent operation designs.
The shared validator/serializer narrows independence; no unseen-operation generalization or representation advantage was established.

claims.statement: The consumer matched its finite structural controls and a separate verifier rejected declared output mutations.
claims.model: Two equivalent serializations normalized to typed required closure and separately retained history.
claims.test_or_argument: 51 authored control families in two forms; 102 executions; 12 verifier mutations; verifier code written separately within the same agent family.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: Boolean/number equality and omitted normalized relations were corrected before freeze; arbitrary inputs remain outside proof.
limits: Finite authored controls, not proof for all JSON inputs.
Same agent family, not external certification.
Original frozen controls, implementation, profile, verifier and concrete mutants are not fully recovered; exact missing hashes are in historical-recovery-gaps.json.
claims.public_reproduction: retained_qualification_report; complete original consumer closure not distributed here

claims.statement: Both representations satisfied the frozen primary rubric on all five related agent task pairs.
claims.model: Ten fresh-context responses; one per case and representation; 24 prescribed projections.
claims.test_or_argument: Structural verification by a separately written same-family verifier, then unmasked source-based semantic review.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: Both forms reach equal primary outcomes; no graph advantage follows.
limits: Reviewer unmasked and within same agent family.
No human expert review; one response per arm.
Unknown exact model revision, decoding, tokens, latency and cost.
84 nested judgments are not an independent sample of size 84.
Both arms scored the rubric maximum on the 24 atomized answered cases; sub-step differences cannot be resolved by that ceiling-bound instrument.
claims.public_reproduction: retained_measured_results; native model reproduction not available

claims.statement: A minimal reachable entity set can include unnecessary claims inside a shared qualification.
claims.model: Entity closure does not decompose every proposition inside text.
claims.test_or_argument: Inspection of two table-value projections after the frozen evaluation.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: A shared applicability note repeats a separate numerical result whose calculation node is not selected.
limits: Additional statements were correct under the frozen rubric.
A finer claim-addressing contract is an implication, not a demonstrated feature.

claims.statement: Reuse preservation requires a sound prior assessment, complete relevant dependencies and request components, preserved interpretation under every allowed transformation output, and discharge of every mandatory new-request condition.
claims.model: Finite property set P, sufficient dependency interface D, equivalent relevant inputs and transformation T.
claims.test_or_argument: Strengthened conditional argument plus invented omitted-legend and missing-gate counterexamples. The new synthetic admission profile checks all nine required gates.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: The listed numeric value stays equal while an omitted sign convention changes the result.
claims.result: Equal incomplete dependency lists cannot establish the premise needed for preservation.
limits: Natural-language dependency completeness is not established by a Boolean annotation.
Synthetic arithmetic does not validate a production semantic extractor.

Dependency equality alone does not entail relevance to a new query or new mandatory requirements. The corrected theorem states those premises explicitly; the program does not discover them semantically.

claims.statement: A negative, count, complete-set or exact-top-k result depends on scope membership and search policy as well as positive item identities.
claims.model: Exhaustive query over a declared accessible domain.
claims.test_or_argument: New empty-domain-to-matching-item finite example.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: An empty positive read-set is unchanged after insertion of a matching candidate, but the absence claim becomes false.
claims.result: Domain dependencies are required for such completeness claims.
limits: No claim that a real search implementation is exhaustive.
Scope access and ranking policy also need declared dependencies.

claims.statement: Strict savings under the homogeneous declared model require N[rho(G-c_r)-c_v] > F(N), with every cost counted once over the same horizon.
claims.model: C0=NG; C1=F+NV+NhR+N(1-h)G, F=B+MG+I+S.
claims.test_or_argument: Algebra and exact rational arithmetic for four invented scenarios, including storage overhead that grows with request count.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: At h=0.9,G=10,R=1,V=9,F=0,N=100, reuse loses 90 invented units.
limits: Costs are synthetic, not measured prices, resource traces or model costs.
The closed threshold floor(F/d)+1 requires d>0 and overhead, hit fraction and unit costs independent of N over the declared horizon.
Observed hit counts are integers; expected rho and observed H_N are distinct.
Equal admissible quality and non-overlapping cost categories are premises.
Historical keys V,R,h remain unchanged in the old program and map to current c_v,c_r,rho.

claims.statement: Separately computed savings from overlapping cache layers cannot simply be added.
claims.model: One cold operation costs 10; provider cache costs 6; prepared artifact costs 1.
claims.test_or_argument: Exact new arithmetic illustration and retained analytical source.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: Adding 4 and 9 claims 13 units saved from a 10-unit operation.
claims.result: Combined benefit must use one complete policy comparison or a non-overlapping decomposition.
limits: No provider billing or resource telemetry was measured.
Utility and downstream harm require separate outcome evidence.

claims.statement: Both retained edits passed the supplied-claim preservation review and scored 8/10; reviewer preference was a tie.
claims.model: One 804-word Russian scientific section, common brief, baseline and toolkit-assisted conditions.
claims.test_or_argument: Both editors received the section, common context, protected-claim registry and rubric. The 19 supplied claims include eight distinctions nested in claim 11; condition labels were revealed after written review.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: The strong common brief may already be sufficient for this section; the baseline also succeeds.
limits: One section, one retained response per condition, one same-environment agent reviewer.
First-completed status is the editors’ declaration; no complete generation event log establishes that each text was the first produced response.
The first three rubric axes scored 2/2 in both arms, and sub-step differences were unresolvable; equal scores do not establish equal quality.
The baseline could have prior general writing knowledge and had the same claim checklist; the experiment does not isolate toolkit knowledge acquisition.
Gate reasoning was templated; the six examined issues, including the accepted BETA-SCOPE-01 change, are reported in the study.
No cost, token or latency measurement, external human review or scientific-truth validation.
claims.public_reproduction: exact texts and review are public; native agent experiment not replayed

claims.statement: Identities of the two retained texts and their declared literal/structure invariants can be rechecked from the public records.
claims.model: Frozen source, protected-literal registry, first responses and original result hashes.
claims.test_or_argument: New public checker verifies hashes, 37 literals, headings, anchor order and link destinations.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: An edit can preserve literal strings while altering meaning; the semantic score is not computed by this checker.
limits: This is record verification, not a new model run or an automated semantic judgment.
A matching output hash does not establish response order, absence of discarded attempts or semantic preservation.

claims.statement: The toolkit-assisted response had a consistent declared trace from request through changes and review.
claims.model: Versioned request, contract, context, output, assessment and receipt bindings.
claims.test_or_argument: Separate technical audit of 12 change groups, 20 change grounds, 7 process grounds, 49 text locators and 24 source ranges.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: Loaded skills do not establish use; cited grounds do not prove causation or observe every internal action.
limits: Third-party source ranges are not redistributed.
Auditability does not establish superiority over baseline or causal contribution of each skill.
The source audit supported 15 fragments and nine rules; K10 is a general precision principle applied by the editor, not an independently established book-specific pronoun rule.
K02/F02 and K03/F03 had local OCR locator issues, and the audit did not inspect the PDF; source-locator consistency is not authenticated page fidelity.
claims.public_reproduction: published audit report and public output records; full source-range audit needs original restricted sources

claims.statement: The corrected authored situation-state model matched 21 finite control outcomes and detected three selected disabled guards; the preserved initial passing suite missed a subsequently reproduced delayed-derivation defect.
claims.model: Synthetic observations, one integer clock domain, local premise versions, typed unknown/conflict states and abstract positive integer context costs.
claims.test_or_argument: 18 predeclared authored controls plus three review-added controls; three separate freshness/closure/scope negative mutations; same-controller review reproduced delayed-premise and snapshot failures before correction.
claims.counterexample_or_rival: The initial 18/18 suite passed while an obsolete delayed derivation incorrectly became READY. A valid delayed positive in the corrected suite rejects an always-refuse repair; selected disabled guards are detected without exceptions.
limits: Author-designed and implementation-informed finite cases; no population error rate or exhaustive proof.
Review uses the same controller/model family; actual independence NOT_VERIFIED.
No authenticated external producers, real permissions, effect execution, distributed clocks, persistence or live consumer.
Abstract costs are not measured tokens; LLM performance and total operational cost remain unmeasured.
claims.public_reproduction: Standard-library runner and exact authored fixtures are distributed; replay from a temporary study copy to preserve retained evidence.

review_scopes.basis: Existing index scope retained without changing prior claims or their evidence; this label is not a new review receipt.
New finite demonstration with bounded same-controller non-author review. Actual independence, empirical agent benefit and native admission NOT_VERIFIED.
